_comment: DSH multi-window launcher configuration for Yocheved's laptop (DESKTOP-FGV6KMH). ONE server, MANY windows. Copied from the owner's fleet config with the paths and the default workspace changed for this machine.

_modes.single: One DSH server on primaryPort; every window attaches to it. Sessions are independent; the engine is shared. THIS IS THE ONLY SUPPORTED MODE.
_modes.multi: UNSUPPORTED on a shared DSH_HOME - do not use. Two dsh web processes on one home have been observed writing duplicate sequence numbers into one session log and making the whole history unloadable. It is also ~1.4 GB per engine.

_notes.whyWorkspaceIsLptHub: The window workspace is the agent's default workspace root. It is set to the shop's records repo rather than the whole C:\Users\cheve\code so that the DEFAULT reach is the job, and the harness configuration the machine itself runs on is never inside a writable workspace root. The other repos (harness-config, personal-secretary-mvp) are still readable and usable from a session that needs them; this only decides what a fresh window opens on.
_notes.nodeTls: This machine sits behind the Techloq TLS-intercepting filter. Node must be told to trust the filter CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and must avoid IPv6 via NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first. Machine-scope environment variables are NOT reliably inherited by service-spawned processes on this box (measured 2026-09-14), so dshw-launch sets both explicitly.

_multiPorts._comment: Only read in mode 'multi'. Ports are assigned from basePort upward, in window order.
